attchmntText: TARC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: TARC Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company noted limited review reports issued by its Statutory Auditor. Consolidated net profit for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was 3,844.82 Lakhs. This compares to a net loss of 1,576.59 Lakhs for the same period in the previous year. Revenue from operations for the half year was 34,594.01 Lakhs. Earnings per equity share stood at 1.30 Rupees. The Board meeting commenced at 14:30 Hrs and concluded at 18:15 Hrs. Financial statements and disclosures are enclosed with the announcement.

attchmntText: TARC Limited has informed the Exchange about reconstitution of Committees of the Board.
TARC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
